content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to connect a [company_name] [product_name] with another PLC from a different manufacturer that supports serial (RS485) communication. If the AB 1400 PLC provides both serial and TCP/IP connectivity, is it possible to connect my [product_name] [article_no] and the AB1400 together? Apologies for my English. Thanks in advance.
No, the [product_name] only supports TCP/IP using the [version_no] protocol and does not support RS485 or similar serial connections.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered a limitation trying to connect a [company_name] [product_name] ([version_no]) to another PLC via RS485, realizing that the hardware supports only TCP/IP with the [version_no] protocol and not RS485. This restricts integration with devices from other manufacturers using serial connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the [company_name] [product_name] to support RS485 serial communication, seeking more flexible connectivity for linking with other PLCs.
